_note: Every command-line flag GhostAgent\agent\ghost_agent.py can pass to llama-server.exe (REQUIRED_SERVER_FLAGS and OPTIONAL_SERVER_FLAGS there; a test keeps the two in step). The build's smoke test runs each backend's llama-server.exe --help and looks for each flag, so a llama.cpp version that drops or renames one is caught at build time instead of on the first start. At run time the agent reads --help once per build as well and leaves out any optional flag the build does not know, with a one-line notice.
_required: Flags passed on every start (or, for --list-devices, on every start with a GPU build). A backend whose --help lacks one of these fails the build: the agent cannot work without them.
_optional: Flags passed only in some cases (a GPU layout, a model profile or a setting), or added to llama.cpp after b11669. A backend whose --help lacks one of these gets a warning; the agent then starts llama-server without that flag.

_optional_when.--no-reasoning-preserve: a mixture-of-experts profile (fast, fast-q8) with preserve_reasoning off (its default there); the dense accurate profile, and any profile with preserve_reasoning on, keeps the server's default (preserve)
_optional_when.--checkpoint-min-step: every start (the checkpoint_min_step setting); left out by builds that do not know it
_optional_when.--cache-ram: every start (the cache_ram_mib setting); left out by builds that do not know it
_optional_when.--cors-origins: every start (part of the lock-down); left out by builds that do not know it
_optional_when.--no-slots: every start (part of the lock-down); left out by builds that do not know it
_optional_when.--no-webui: the web_ui setting is false (the default)
_optional_when.--device: a GPU was found, or "--device none" when a GPU build runs without a usable GPU
_optional_when.--moe-cache-mib: explicit MoE layout with at least 256 MiB left for the expert cache
_optional_when.--fit-target: llama.cpp fits the layout itself (the dense profile, little free VRAM, or the auto-fit retry)
_optional_when.--moe-cache-cpu-share: the moe_cache_cpu_share setting is set (tuning runs; llama.cpp b12359 and later)
